name: terminal-desk
description: A side panel for Claude Code: things Claude left undone, where your context went, cost, and whether the prompt cache is still warm.

autoOpen.title: Open the desk at startup
autoOpen.description: Open the desk pane when a session starts (it docks beside the transcript in a wide fullscreen terminal).

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto reads it from the transcript; or force 5m or 1h.

warnPercent.title: Context warning at (%)
warnPercent.description: Show a yellow warning to /clear or /compact when the context is this full.

urgentPercent.title: Urgent context warning at (%)
urgentPercent.description: Turn the warning red and pin it above the prompt at this fill.
